package.description: Efficient product, design and development collaboration platform

en-US.description: Efficient product, design and development collaboration platform
en-US.longDescription: MODAO, an integrated online collaboration platform for product design, is an essential tool for designers, product managers and development teams. It integrates prototyping, online version of Sketch designer tools, flowcharts and mind maps, supports real-time collaboration and management of team projects, features financial-level data security, and supports private deployment.
en-US.name: mockingbot-studio

zh-CN.longDescription: 墨刀是产品设计一体化在线协同办公平台，集原型设计，线上版 Sketch 设计师工具、流程图、思维导图为一体，支持团队项目实时协作和管理，金融级数据安全保障，还支持私有化部署，是设计师、产品经理和技术开发团队必备工具。
zh-CN.name: mockingbot-studio
